entities.summary: The Catholic Church in Sudan and South Sudan is composed ofone Latin hierarchy, united in one single episcopal conference, designated as Sudan Catholic Bishops' Conference, comprising an ecclesiastical province under a Metropolitan Archdiocese per country, with a total of 7 suffragan dioceses. three Eastern Catholic transnational jurisdictions, each covering both countries.
